hub.rationale: Sholinganallur is the only candidate that is central to the corridor geometry, the OMR rail line boundary and the GCC free-supply network. Mean distance from the 50 localities to Sholinganallur is 6.5 km; to Navalur it would be 9.4 km and to Thiruvanmiyur 8.7 km, and both of those sit at one end of the long thin ECR leg rather than at its centre.
